- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/014_S1.10__compilation-model.md` (cites `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md`
  §3.2 R-2.1.3 only — the C0/Stage-1 slice per §3.2.14: stages 0–2 and 5, `RuntimePlan/1`,
  trace map, `derivation_key`/`bundle_id`, `ModelProfile/1` + debt-record schemas,

  subset is the subset the Stage-1 fixtures exercise).
- **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.9` @ `b236333`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.10`

  sealed definition without re-resolving any selector. **Unblocked by this ticket** — the
  consumer lands here; verify `link` calls `hh_assembly::link_precheck`, an unpinned
  `version_selector` refuses `C-LINK-1`, a resolved sealed definition links with zero
  resolutions. Target: close as DONE.
- DF-S1.9-1 (out-of-process variant host), DF-S1.9-2 (Stage-3+ composition/sweep ops),
  DF-S1.9-4 (cross-ADR rung audit — CAP.1), DF-S0.3-2, DF-S0.3-3 (R2 residual),
  DF-S1.2-2, DF-S1.3-2, DF-S1.5-1/-2/-3, DF-S1.8-1 — **not unblocked** (Stage-2/3,

## Requirements
Satisfy + stamp: **R-2.1.3** (§3.2 C0/Stage-1 per §3.2.14).

Landed surface (this ticket):
- New persistent crate `crates/hh-compiler` — the C0/Stage-1 compilation model. Deps only:
  hh-wire, hh-identity, hh-provenance, hh-ontology, hh-hir, hh-assembly (CC5/CC10).
- **Stage 0 accept** (`accept`): sealed-definition input only (typed `SealedDefinition` +
  canonical-bytes seam `accept_bytes`); calls `hh_assembly::validate_assembly` (never
  re-implements `validate` — ADR-0025 D2); re-asserts the canonical-form hash matches the
  recorded `version_id`; refuses `NotSealed` / `NonCanonicalInput` /
  `InvalidDefinition[AssemblyDiagnostic]`.
- **Stage 1 link** (`link(sealed, profile_refs[], target_refs[], variant_view?)`):
  `hh_assembly::link_precheck` first — any surviving `version_selector` is `C-LINK-1`
  `LinkError{unbound_slot}` (closes DF-S1.9-3); resolves nothing §3.3 owns (no resolver in
  the signature — zero resolutions by construction; the variant view is pinned-`version_id`
  lookup only); binds the profile chain (`extends`, selector precedence/specificity,
  `AmbiguousSelector` on ties, chain overrides ⊆ owned fields under per-field merge policy);
  `capability_requires` preconditions checked (a `PreconditionDomain::Capability` requires
  a `depends-on` edge to another `ToolCapability`); conditioned-rule debt completeness —
  `LinkError{missing_debt_record}`; expired rules → warning diagnostics; every slot bound;
  `NoProfile` unless a `fallback_profile` with a dated debt hypothesis is bound;
  `LinkError{version_conflict | unknown_target}`.
- **Stage 2 lower-native** (`lower_native(linked) → RuntimePlan/1`): closed plan-node
  kinds `{loop, step, branch-on-validator, delegate, stop-rule}`; step.mode /
  step.output_schema / loop.replan_on attributes (ADR-0103); the control boundary's
  envelope lowers into the budget-envelope + stop-rule nodes (ADR-0106); tool table;
  policy tables derived only from `Permission`/`EffectClass`/`Budget`; context-policy
  parameters; validator bindings; artifact/ledger ids; `hir_node_id` on every node;
  `PlanError{unsupported_construct}` — never a silent fallback.
- **Stage 5 seal** (`seal_outputs` → `CompiledBundle`): `derivation_key` = `idp/1` id over
  canonical inputs `{definition version_id, bound variant version_ids, profile content
  hashes, target-spec versions, compiler version}`; `bundle_id` = `idp/1` id over canonical
  outputs; `SealError{non_canonical}` on re-encode mismatch; no run-time value referenced.
- **Schemas** (`schema.rs`, the single source — CC7): `ModelProfile/1`
  (`{profile_id, version, content_hash, selector{provider_api_family, model_family,
  version_pattern ∈ {exact|prefix|range|any}, precedence, successor_ref?, retirement_at?,
  roles_admitted}, extends?, capabilities: CapabilityDeclaration, rules: ProfileRule[],
  ext?, expiry, compatibility{inventory_version, min_compiler_version}}`), `ProfileRule`
  (closed 13-kind enum), profile debt record (the §3.2.3 lifecycle vocabulary over the one
  CF-049 field shape), `SurfaceArgMap` (closed transform enum), `SurfaceBinding`
  (ADR-0090), `EquivalenceEvidence{E1..E7: pass|fail|n/a(reason)}`, `RuntimePlan/1`,
  `ToolBinding`, `PolicyTables`, `BudgetEnvelope`, `ValidatorBinding`, `TraceMap`,
  `LcdReport` + `BenchmarkConditionedRule`, `LoweringLossReport`, `ConformanceRecord`,
  `CompiledBundle`, `TargetSpec`, `LinkedGraph`, `CompileInputs`.
- **`check_equivalence(surface, capability_ref, suite?) → EquivalenceEvidence`** — E1
  (effect equality over the declared set), E2 (arg-map totality + domain membership), E3
  (precondition-domain preservation — schema inclusion over the OQ-219 interim keyword
  subset; narrowing declared `narrowed`, widening is `fail`), E7 (accounting/identity —
  `trace_map(S) ∋ C.semantic_id`); E4 `n/a{stage_3|open-world}` (T-LCD-15 — never 0/fail),
  E5/E6 `n/a{stage_3}` (§5b/§5f own them; §3.2.14).
- **`trace(bundle, locator)`** — total over every emitted stage-1 element (control nodes,
  tool bindings, policy rows, validator bindings, envelope, context-policy params) →
  `{hir_node_ids[], rule_ids[], target_rule_ids[]}`; unknown locator is a typed error.
- **`lcd_report(sealed, profiles[], targets[])`** — composes stage-0 `validate_assembly`
  derived results (never recomputes — CF-050): `benchmark_conditioned_rules`,
  `identity_stability`, `hosting_edges`, `opacity_ratio`, `conditioned_rules` (profile +
  definition homes), `per_profile_diff_fields` (owned fields ∪ metered `ext` use),
  `lowering_loss` (`[]` — stage 4 lands at S3.2).
- `hh-compile` binary — the out-of-process seam (AC-CP-11, T-LCD-12): canonical
  `CompileInputs` bytes on stdin → canonical bundle (or typed diagnostics) on stdout.
- Staged later (§3.2.14, NOT this ticket): stages 3/4 (`lower_profile`, `lower_target`),
  `lift`, `relower`, loss reports per target, E4 fixture suite, E5/E6, executable
  T-LCD-03/-04/-11, the two minimal C0 profiles (ship with stage 3 — they exist to be
  lowered), `ProviderRequestPlan`/`ProtocolBinding` records (stage-4 artifacts),
  `model.surface.relowered` emission (ledger row lands with `relower`).

## Acceptance criteria (gating — §3.2.12; deterministic halves executable)
- **AC-CP-01** — two compiles of identical inputs yield byte-identical bundles (in-process
  twice + once through `hh-compile`); the compile signature takes no clock/env input.
- **AC-CP-02 (T-01)** — Stage 3 (two lowered profiles) → deferral row → S3.2.
- **AC-CP-03** — every emitted stage-1 element resolves through `trace`.
- **AC-CP-05** — a profile rule requiring an inexpressible surface raises
  `UnexpressibleSurface` as an error (non-`native_fc` `interaction_mode`, `tool_shape`
  naming a family outside the C0 set, undeclared dialect narrowing).
- **AC-CP-06 (T-05)** — Stage-1 half: incomplete debt → `missing_debt_record`; expired rule
  warns + lands in `lcd_report.conditioned_rules`. Stage-3 half ("retire rule R" →
  `relower`) → deferral row → S3.2.
- **AC-CP-09** — Stage 3 (`relower`) → deferral row → S3.2.
- **AC-CP-10** — Stage-1 half: every compiled surface record carries E1–E3/E7 `pass`
  (or typed `fail`/`n/a`); E4 `n/a(open-world)` for open-world capabilities.
- **AC-CP-11 (T-12)** — `hh-compile` out-of-process run produces bytes identical to the
  in-process compile.
- **AC-CP-13** — Stage 3 (MCP catalogue) → deferral row → S3.2.

## Plan
1. `crates/hh-compiler` skeleton + `Cargo.toml` + workspace member.
2. `schema.rs` — canonical codecs for every record (CC7: one source, both directions).
3. `errors.rs` — the §3.2.10 closed failure set as a typed sum.
4. `profile.rs` — `ModelProfile/1` model + chain binding + debt checks.
5. `link.rs` — stage 1 (link_precheck first; profile chain; capability_requires; slot
   bound-ness; target-spec binding; variant pinned-lookup view).
6. `plan.rs` — `RuntimePlan/1` + `lower_native` (procedures → plan nodes; envelope →
   budget + stop-rules; policies from entities only).
7. `trace.rs`, `equiv.rs`, `lcd.rs`, `seal.rs`, `compiler.rs` — the remaining ops +
   `compile` orchestration.
8. `src/bin/hh-compile.rs` — out-of-process seam.
9. Tests: unit per module + `tests/acceptance.rs` driving the AC matrix end-to-end.
10. ADRs, deferral updates, verification, PR, closeout.

## Progress
- Branch created `svitali/harnessharness-s1.10` @ `b236333`; `cargo check --workspace`
  baseline green.
- Crate skeleton + all modules landed; unit (46) + acceptance (12) suites green.
- **Phase-3 self-review finding (corrected in-run):** the first `ProfileRuleKind` draft
  invented a 14-kind set (`required_fields`, `reasoning_format`, `stop_text`, …) instead
  of the canonical §3.2.3 thirteen — and `ProfileCapabilities` carried a hand-picked
  field list. Both were rewritten to the spec's sets verbatim (the closed
  `{tool_shape, naming, schema_dialect, description_template, error_format,
  result_render, prompt_layout, interaction_mode, transcript_render,
  compaction_reminder, sampling_defaults, caching_markers, procedure_target}` enum; the
  `CapabilityDeclaration` field list incl. structured `reasoning_replay{field, opaque}`);
  the `tests{…}` member was added to `ModelProfile` (carried as `Json` — §5b owns its
  semantics at Stage 5). Tests were re-pointed (`SamplingDefaults` covers the conditioned-
  rule debt cases; the closed-set test now asserts the canonical thirteen spellings).
  ADR-0241 §3 records the ruling.
- Phase 5 verification: `cargo test --workspace` all-green (hh-compiler 46 unit + 12
  acceptance); `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --
  -D warnings` clean; `check-build-memory` 0 violations (the BM-ADR-04 spec-appendix-vs-
  repo-file-set warning is the standing 3-vs-4-digit ADR-numbering difference,
  unchanged since S1.9).
